## Problem and resulting behaviour

Explain the issue and what the user will experience after this change.

## Related issue

Link the issue, if applicable.

## Verification

List commands run and their results. Explain skipped or unavailable checks.

## Screenshots or recording

Include redacted before/after images for visual changes, if applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows CONTRIBUTING.md and the product principles.
- [ ] Relevant tests, typechecks, and builds passed, or limitations are explained above.
- [ ] UI changes cover both languages, keyboard/touch controls, pause, and Back navigation where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation and placeholder environment variables reflect the change.
- [ ] New media has documented sources and redistribution rights.
- [ ] The diff contains no credentials, private signing keys, generated output, or personal/child data.
